# dsh-oc-go-usage

A DSH plugin that shows what the current session cost on an OpenCode Go subscription. It adds
an **O

pencode Go** tab to the session header, next to Chat and Trajectory, and a
`/opencode-go` command th
at prints the same numbers as text.
## What the tab shows

- Total cost, request count, and token totals for the session window, split into input,
output and c

ache reads
- Cost and request count per model
- The six most recent requests
- Cost and request coun

t per local hour
- DSH session figures read from the host: turns, steps, LLM and tool time, tokens p

er second,
cache hit rate, and context composition
- **Refresh**, and **Save .txt**, which writes a
plain-text snapshot into a folder you pick
## How the numbers are computed

OpenCode keeps one row per inference request in the console request log, with `startedAt`,
`finished
At`, model, token counts, outcome and `cost` in USD. The plugin queries that log:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`since` is the DSH session's `header.createdAt` and `until` is the current time, so the query
window
is the session lifetime. The total is the sum of `cost` over the rows inside it.

Rows are matched by time, not by session id. Another client using the same OpenCode Go
workspace dur
ing the window is counted too.
## Requirements

- DSH with the Web GUI
- An OpenCode Go subscription
- Access to the OpenCode console at opencode.ai
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or in the GUI: Settings, Plugins, Add plugin, then paste `github:x01Jin/dsh-oc-go-usage`.
Restart DS
H or reload the page. The tab appears on a session once it has started.
## Connect

The request log needs the console session, not an API key. A personal `oc_sk_...` key returns
403 on

needs the console session, not an API key. A personal `oc_sk_...` key returns
403 on this endpoint.

1. Open <https://opencode.ai/console> and open the browser DevTools Network tab.
2. Reload the page

and select any `request-logs` request.
3. Copy the full value of its `cookie` request header.
4. Ope

n the session's **Opencode Go** tab, paste it into **Console session**, and press
**Save**.

The workspace id (`wrk_...` from the console URL) is discovered automatically when the console
allow
s it. If the tab asks for one, paste the id or the full console URL.

A `cookie: ...` header and an `authorization: Bearer ...` value are both accepted. The
credential is

stored in the DSH credential store as `OPENCODE_CONSOLE_COOKIE`, the workspace as
`OPENCODE_CONSOLE
_WORKSPACE`. Only the host process sends it, and only to opencode.ai.
## Snapshots

**Save .txt** opens the system folder picker and writes one snapshot into the chosen folder.
Cancell

the system folder picker and writes one snapshot into the chosen folder.
Cancelling writes nothing.

The file is named `20261028-072459-eb5c23ae.txt` (local time, then the session id), so a folder
of s

napshots sorts by time. It holds the window, totals, derived rates, the host-side DSH
figures, the p

er-model split, a local-hour histogram and the caveats that apply to that
capture.
## Configuration
All keys are optional.
| key | default | meaning |

| `credentialRef` | `OPENCODE_CONSOLE_COOKIE` | DSH credential holding the console session |
| `apiB

ase` | `https://opencode.ai` | console origin |
| `cacheMs` | `20000` | how long one console answer

is reused |
| `maxPages` | `25` | page cap for one read, 100 rows per page |
| `routePrefix` | `/ope

ncode-go` | path prefix of the local routes |
| `orgId` | unset | workspace id when discovery is ref

go` | path prefix of the local routes |
| `orgId` | unset | workspace id when discovery is refused |

`credentialRef` can name an environment variable, because DSH credentials fall back to the
process e

Ref` can name an environment variable, because DSH credentials fall back to the
process environment.
## Routes
The browser half never talks to opencode.ai.
| method | path | purpose |
| `GET` | `/opencode-go/session-cost` | totals for one session, `session` and `refresh` query params

|
| `POST` | `/opencode-go/session-cookie` | store the credential and optional workspace |
| `DELET

E` | `/opencode-go/session-cookie` | forget both |
| `POST` | `/opencode-go/session-export` | write
the snapshot into a chosen folder |
## Limits

- The tab refreshes every 30 s while a session is open; the host caches one console answer for
20 s.

- The console keeps request logs for 30 days. A session older than that returns partial data
and th

e tab labels it.
- The console session expires with the browser session. When the tab says unauthori

zed, paste a
fresh cookie.
- A resumed session keeps one window from its original start, so the time

in between is counted
when it falls in the same workspace.
- Rows without a `cost` are counted but
not summed, and the panel reports how many.
## Development

and re
gistration of the client bundle in a stubbed module loader.
